about: Starter evaluation set for Vouch Shield. SYNTHETIC: every message here was written for this project, modelled on publicly documented recruitment-scam patterns and ordinary recruiter outreach. It measures whether the rules behave as designed on realistic wording. It is NOT evidence of real-world accuracy. Replace or extend it with real, anonymised messages collected in the pilot before quoting any number outside this repo.

items.label: fraud
items.body: Dear Candidate, congratulations! You are selected for the post of Software Trainee without interview. To confirm your seat pay a refundable security deposit of Rs 4,999 via UPI within 24 hours. Send Aadhaar on WhatsApp.

items.label: fraud
items.body: Dear Student, we are offering a 3 month virtual internship with guaranteed certificate. A one-time registration fee of Rs 1,499 is applicable for training material. Last 12 seats, act fast.

items.label: fraud
items.note: task scam: no fee mentioned yet, only the lure
items.body: Hello, part time work from home opportunity. Earn Rs 3000 daily by rating hotels online, no experience needed. Message our manager on Telegram to start today.

items.label: fraud
items.body: Hi, I am from the Northwind hiring team. Please complete your application on our portal: northwind-careers.co/apply and upload your documents there.

items.body: Welcome aboard! Before your start date you need to purchase your work laptop from our approved vendor. Send the payment by Zelle and it will be added to your first paycheck.

items.label: legit
items.body: Hi Neil, I came across your Raft implementation and wanted to reach out. We have an SDE intern opening on our storage team. Would you be open to a 30 minute call this week?

items.label: legit

items.label: legit

items.body: A reminder as you go through our process: we never charge candidates any registration fee, at any stage. If anyone asks you for money in our name, please report it to us.

items.label: legit
